result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and continuous sidewalks in a residential setting. While basic infrastructure like traffic signals and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or traffic calming measures increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a median refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to provide clear crossing intervals separate from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and reduce the speed of turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve clarity and safety for people crossing.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and lack of physical traffic calming measures leave pedestrians exposed to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a refuge island or median.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Large vehicle conflict
hazards.description: A large SUV is positioned within the intersection, highlighting potential conflict points and visibility issues for smaller pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow turning vehicles and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks, sidewalks, and a dedicated bike lane. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure time when crossing multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two travel lanes, a bike lane, and a wide painted median, increasing exposure to vehicular traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway crossing at the foreground crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Refuge
hazards.description: The center median is painted rather than raised, offering no physical protection for pedestrians who may need to wait mid-crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the main roadway within the crosswalk area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised concrete refuge island in the center median to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time safely.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks on all visible corners, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signal heads and the wide, open geometry suggest a vehicle-oriented design that may encourage higher speeds.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks visible pedestrian signal heads, leaving pedestrians without clear guidance on when it is safe to cross.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for high-speed right turns, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.
